description: FIRST DRAFT sizing (kept to show the check catching it): ASTER-T1 (synthetic) body, radius 400 m, density 2000 kg/m^3, 6 h rotation. The draft tried to reach a sampling site 500 m away in a single 45-degree hop, which needs v = sqrt(range * g_net) ~ 0.31 m/s. Superseded by lowg-cases.json.
